top_signals.title: Oil Prices Retreat, Apple Results on Deck
top_signals.summary:
A report that says President Donald Trump wants to give diplomacy with Iran more time helped ease pressure on oil prices, with Brent falling more than 3% to below $110 a barrel.

Apple reclaimed the title of world’s most valuable company on Friday, taking the mantle from Nvidia as investors seek the perceived safety of the iPhone maker amid concerns about artificial intelligence spending.

The Opening Trade has everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game. Hosted by Anna Edwards, Guy Johnson and Tom Mackenzie. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: UK cyber consulting set for explosive growth after wave of AI attacks
top_signals.summary: British cyber consulting is poised for an explosion in growth as boardroom paranoia over AI and hacking fuels demand for external expertise, research has suggested. The UK’s cybersecurity consulting market is expected to have grown about 17 per cent to £2.2bn this year, up from 9.8 per cent in 2025, according to Source Global Research. [...]
